title: Swap VS logo to newly uploaded optimized static asset

requirements.summary: Add optimized uploaded logo as a generated static asset and replace the current VS logo in the header and home hero.
acceptanceCriteria: A new static image file derived from `IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png` exists under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and is referenced via an `/assets/generated/...` URL.
`frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx` no longer renders `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`; it renders the new uploaded image asset instead.
`frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx` no longer renders `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png`; it renders the new uploaded image asset instead.
The new logo renders correctly on both desktop and mobile layouts without distortion (keeps aspect ratio) and without layout shifts in the header or hero sections.

file_operations.description: Create a web-optimized PNG derived from `IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.png`, preserving transparent/white background, centered composition, sized to 512x512.

Replace the logo image source `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` with `/assets/generated/IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.dim_512x512.png` and ensure the rendered logo keeps aspect ratio and reserves space (avoid layout shift) for both desktop and mobile header layouts.

Replace the hero logo image source `/assets/generated/vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` with `/assets/generated/IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.dim_512x512.png` and ensure the rendered logo keeps aspect ratio and does not cause layout shifts.

requirements.summary: Remove remaining primary-branding references to the previous VS logo so the new uploaded logo is the only one shown across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Searching the frontend source for `vs-appliances-logo-uploaded.dim_512x512.png` returns zero matches (or only legacy/commented references not used at runtime).
Previewing key pages (Home, Services, Track Status, Register, My Requests, Admin Login) shows the new uploaded logo in the header consistently.

file_operations.description: Introduce a single source of truth for branding assets (e.g., exported logo src and alt text) pointing to `/assets/generated/IMG_20260212_214859~2-1.dim_512x512.png` so future pages/components don’t reintroduce the old logo path.
Refactor to consume the centralized branding constant(s) so no hardcoded legacy logo path remains in the header.
Refactor to consume the centralized branding constant(s) so no hardcoded legacy logo path remains in the hero section.
